summary: The narrative now separates the service relationship, financial evidence and a proposed charitable destination. The receipt settles first; the optional Foundation gift changes total payment only.
Reported company finances teach cost coverage without estimating OpenAI customer margins. The worksheet remains optional and starts with unknown costs.
method: This is a bounded review of the relationship/Foundation refinement, plus relevant billing and scenario regressions. It does not certify every historical feature.

Visual review used cloud Chrome, responsive iframes and 16px/32px root text. Screen captures are retained in review/relationship-foundation. Native device behavior, real browser zoom, tax eligibility and a live donation channel are not established.
Public benchmark figures were checked against the primary Anthropic S-1/A, Results of Operations and Note 8. Financial scenarios are hypothetical user inputs. No payment or message was sent.
changes: Named the OpenAI Foundation and charitable purpose before gift selection, separating the service bill, gift and total payment.
Removed featured speculative margin targets; moved sourced accounting evidence ahead of a single optional reviewer worksheet.
Kept gifts outside commercial revenue and earned privileges; kept costs unknown until explicitly supplied and reviewed.
Fixed shared worksheet links and nested direct navigation.
Updated editorial chapters, Markdown, JSON, agent index and source download while preserving the original source corpus and adopted equation.

cases.title: Calculation and scenario regression suite
cases.action: Run node --test tests/*.test.mjs.
cases.expected: Billing boundaries, cost completeness, negative balances, donation exclusion, shared-state parsing and legacy migration remain correct.
cases.actual: 37 tests passed. The scenario round-trip case also verifies the new cost-scenario link target.

cases.title: Type safety and patch integrity
cases.action: Run TypeScript --noEmit and git diff --check.
cases.expected: No type errors or whitespace errors.
cases.actual: Both completed successfully.

cases.title: Source preservation and archive targets
cases.action: Compare original source HTML/JSON and canonical billing/equation modules with the starting commit; inspect local archive links.
cases.expected: Historical evidence and adopted math unchanged; current archive targets exist.
cases.actual: All four files are byte-identical to the starting commit. 150 local link/file references checked; none missing.

cases.title: Reported finances reconcile
cases.action: Recalculate each reported expense per $100 revenue and the operating result from the source amounts.
cases.expected: Expenses total $34,502 million against $33,242 million revenue; operating loss $1,260 million.
cases.actual: The test suite reconciles totals and ratios. UI and current archive present the result as negative $3.79 per $100, not an individual account margin.

cases.title: First-visit donation context
cases.action: Open a fresh receipt.
cases.expected: Settled service bill appears before the optional Foundation donation; default gift is zero.
cases.actual: Visible receipt named the OpenAI Foundation and the charitable purpose before the choices; $100 service bill, $0 gift, $100 total.

cases.title: Preset donation preserves the bill
cases.action: Select a $5 gift on the reference $86.40 metered example.
cases.expected: Subtotal $106.40 settles to $100; only total payment becomes $105.
cases.actual: All values matched and the selected gift had pressed state.

cases.title: Custom gift and usage above $500
cases.action: Enter a $7.23 gift and $585.25 metered usage, then open economics.
cases.expected: Subtotal $605.25 settles to $600; total $607.23; provider revenue $600.
cases.actual: Receipt and linked provider bill matched exactly. No $200 ceiling or permanent $500 cap appeared.

cases.title: Unknown costs stay unknown
cases.action: Open the optional reviewer worksheet with blank cost fields.
cases.expected: No balance; review control disabled; all missing categories identified.
cases.actual: All four cost categories were Unknown and no earnings estimate was displayed.

cases.title: Reviewed complete cost scenario
cases.action: For a $100 service bill, enter $40 serving, $30 development, $10 operations and 3% payment costs; review.
cases.expected: No result before review; $17 scenario balance after review.
cases.actual: The result appeared only after confirmation and was labeled before financing and tax, not OpenAI profit.

cases.title: Foundation gifts excluded from commercial calculations
cases.action: Change the gift from $5 to $10 while retaining the reviewed cost scenario.
cases.expected: Commercial revenue and balance unchanged.
cases.actual: Provider bill stayed $100 and scenario balance stayed $17.

cases.title: Cost changes and negative results
cases.action: Change development allocation from $30 to $80, then review again.
cases.expected: The previous result disappears until reviewed; revised balance is negative $33.
cases.actual: Review was invalidated immediately; the reviewed result displayed -$33.

cases.title: Direct shared scenario reload
cases.action: Copy the reviewed assumptions link and reload it.
cases.expected: Open the worksheet directly and restore amounts, review status, receipt and gift.
cases.actual: The cost-scenario v4 link opened its drawer and restored the -$33 result with the $100 service bill and $10 gift.

cases.title: Usage changes invalidate cost review
cases.action: Move the receipt slider one keyboard step from $86.40 to $86.41 and return to economics.
cases.expected: The $100 tier stays constant, but prior cost review becomes stale.
cases.actual: Usage increased by $0.01; the balance disappeared and the site requested another cost review.

cases.title: Reset does not reset the customer receipt
cases.action: Clear cost assumptions after editing the receipt.
cases.expected: Costs revert to Unknown while metered use, service bill and gift persist.
cases.actual: All costs cleared; the linked $100 service bill remained. Receipt state was retained in the scenario URL.

cases.title: Nested disclosure direct navigation
cases.action: Load and reload the economics-loyalty anchor.
cases.expected: Both parent worksheet and nested loyalty disclosure open.
cases.actual: Both details elements were open after a fresh reload; the visitor did not need to find a hidden parent.

cases.title: Legacy cost links cannot revive misleading earnings
cases.action: Open an economics v3 link with use=1000, gift=10, servingCost=50 and otherCosts=5.
cases.expected: Preserve the bill and gift; discard incomplete cost defaults; explain the correction.
cases.actual: The service bill was $1,000; cost fields were Unknown and an explicit migration message appeared.

cases.title: Keyboard operation
cases.action: Use an arrow key on the slider, Space on a donation choice, and Enter on the Foundation disclosure.
cases.expected: Equivalent keyboard operation with visible state changes.
cases.actual: Meter advanced by one cent, $1 gift was selected, and the donation/tax-context disclosure expanded.

cases.title: Mobile and enlarged-text visual review
cases.action: Inspect screenshots at 440px and 390px normal text, 320px/390px doubled root text; inspect receipt, evidence, worksheet, formula and archive.
cases.expected: Controls and labels reflow without page-wide horizontal overflow.
cases.actual: Donation controls changed to two columns when necessary; cost rows stacked; long labels remained readable. Measured document width equaled the viewport in checked narrow states. Screenshots are saved beside this report.

cases.title: Desktop visual review
cases.action: Inspect receipt and financial evidence at 1280px with normal and doubled root text.
cases.expected: Readable hierarchy, matching amounts and no label overlap or page-wide overflow.
cases.actual: Both states were visually inspected. Document width matched the viewport. Foundation recipient, reported-loss label and context remained visible and legible.

cases.title: Current archive and runtime checks
cases.action: Open static provider economics, inspect revised financial/donation context, and inspect app-origin error logs.
cases.expected: Static archive matches the app; no app-origin runtime errors in reviewed flow.
cases.actual: Archive showed signed loss and excluded Foundation donations. App-origin error filter returned no entries; browser extension metadata errors were unrelated to the app.

cases.title: Physical devices and assistive technology
cases.action: Test native iPhone Safari, Android touch dragging, actual browser zoom and screen-reader announcements.
cases.expected: Verify behavior on those devices and settings independently.
cases.actual: Not run in this environment. Responsive iframe sizes and doubled root text are not physical-device or actual-browser-zoom tests.
